summary: Student/attendance management app: fix missing 8th/9th class students visibility across screens and add monthly student data export to Excel.
known_issues: Build/deployment attempts intermittently failing with 'AI couldn't implement/complete' errors.

existing_features.title: Add a Monthly Export feature that lets the user download monthly student attendance data as an Excel-compatible CSV file (English headers), with month selection and class/section taken from the current session.

Update the roll-call frontend hooks to use the new backend roll-call APIs (instead of the temporary localStorage implementation) so attendance data and monthly export are consistent across devices/browsers.

new_feature_requests.summary: Fix: 8th and 9th class students not showing anywhere (system prompts to Add Student after selecting class/section); should behave like 7th class and display existing students.
Feature: Download/export student monthly data to Excel.

Fix the backend student lookup so that selecting Class 8 or Class 9 (any section) returns the already-existing students (same behavior as Class 7) instead of appearing empty and prompting users to add students.
Make student storage resilient to canister upgrades so previously added students do not disappear after redeploy/upgrade; ensure any needed indexes/counters are restored correctly on upgrade.
Implement backend roll-call persistence APIs so attendance is stored in the canister (not only in browser localStorage), and can be queried for a given day and for a given month/class/section.

projectName: Fix missing Class 8/9 students across screens and add monthly attendance export to Excel (CSV)
